sections.value: Welcome. This is a minimal blog focused on clarity and speed—inspired by clean, readable sites like Lil'Log.
You'll find posts and projects here, each with tags so you can filter and search. Every post can include text, images, and video while staying lightweight.
To add a new post: add an entry to content/posts/index.json and create content/posts/your-slug.json with full content. Tags are automatic from the data.
